payload.law: the instrument's optional body flashed + verified on device

model.name: flash-session
model.method: PIO upload (env esp32-s3, esp32-s3-devkitc-1) via the onboard FTDI bridge; esptool chip gate pre-flash; boot capture via tools/boot_capture.py; NFF MCP device sheet + offline diagnose

chip_identity_gate.features: Wi-Fi, BT 5 (LE), dual core + LP core, 240 MHz, embedded PSRAM 8 MB (AP_3v3)
chip_identity_gate.note: NFF's auto-ID labels the bridge 'ESP8266 (FTDI)' — the skill's gotcha reproduced live; the silicon behind the bridge is the esptool-verified S3

flashes.env_state: USB-CDC variant (Serial on the native connector)
UART-bridge routing (Serial on UART0 = COM7; the USB-CDC flags retired after the plug-in discovery)
flashes.io_note: the write-progression tail was trimmed from the console capture; the image here is bound by its own hash; esptool reported SUCCESS (hash verified)

lines: [XRF-PORTABLE] boot — the instrument is the code
boot_capture.first_capture_note: the busy capture caught the battery line alone (ROM spew + [BATTERY] 9/9 ALL GREEN)

on_device_battery.note: the device items (F-B1/B2/B3/B5/B7 + B10-ledger class) self-pass; desktop-vouched items remain spoken pointers (chain seq 5) — never faked on device

get_device_info.honesty: the bridge sheet; the auto-ID mislabel is the known gotcha — the FQBN/board choice is NEVER taken from this

nff.diagnose: No crash found: no ESP32 panic signature found in input (the captured boot output)

range_feature.dashboard: SCAN RANGES card: SCAN 10 cm / SCAN 1 m / SCAN 5 m / WHOLE RANGE; results open in a popup overlay
range_feature.honesty: the coin chain is code — the standoff is the declared [MODEL] variable (Law 2397 + the single anchor); the 'full' preset returns each metal's maximal detectable range (the engine detection_range_m port, 1.5 m bisection cap, spoken)
range_feature.compile: both envs green from the identical source (esp32dev + esp32-s3)
range_feature.bit_compat: the standoff parameter carries a default = the design standoff, so every pre-range call site keeps its exact bit pattern

user_gates.dashboard_check: NOT performed from the PC — the user instructed DO NOT CONNECT to the AP (they will verify on their phone); the PC's WLAN profile was registered manually (connectionMode manual — no auto-rejoin) and the connection was severed by the user; no further netsh commands were or will be run without instruction
user_gates.fed_scans: the feed path (open-meteo) needs an STA uplink the device may lack in AP-only mode; waiting_for_link is the honest state until linked (no fabricated numbers, per src/main.cpp)

checks.observed: esptool confirmed ESP32-S3 before any bytes moved
two uploads, esptool 'Hash of data verified' on both
the three boot marker lines captured cleanly
SPOKEN — user will verify on their phone

payload.verdict: FLASH SESSION: PASS — chip gate, both verified flashes, clean boot capture, on-device battery 9/9 ALL GREEN, no crash signature; the dashboard's phone-level check is user-gated (spoken)
payload.scope_line: the body was flashed and the on-device code verified at the boot level; the instrument remains the code chain, and its receipts remain the desktop's (SESSION_CHAIN.jsonl) — the device is not a signer

honesty.REAL: esptool chip identity, esptool flash hashes, the serial captures, NFF device sheet/diagnose, compile sizes
honesty.MODEL: the reading chain on device is the ported model (direct-feed/model provenance, spoken on the dashboard)
honesty.NOT_MEASURED: no drowser-level AP test was performed from this PC (user-gated); no physical coil exists — the range scan is the certified model at declared standoffs
